newsitem.title: TURKEY: Mobil returns to oil search in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Mobil returns to oil search in Turkey.

text.p: Turkey has given an off-shore oil exploration licence to a joint venture between Mobil Exploration Mediterranean Inc, Mobil Corp's exploration and production affiliate in Turkey, and its partner Turkish Petroleum Inc (TPAO), the Official Gazette said on Friday.
It said Mobil Exploration, which abondoned its 30-year-old upstream activities in Turkey last year after the parent company's review, had a 75 percent stake in the joint venture and TPAO 25 percent.
The exploration licences were given for four areas off Antalya coast in the Mediterranean, it said.
TPAO is the biggest oil producer in Turkey, where it produces about 54,000 barrels per day (bpd).
Mobil Corp sold the operation of Mobil Exploration to Petrom Production Ltd, an international operating company based in Ireland whose major shareholder is Momentum Engineering.
At the time of the sale, Mobil Exploration was producing 2,100 bpd of crude from the Salmo field in southeast Turkey.

Mobil officials said they applied to the Turkish government for permission to use a new name for their stake in the joint venture because name rights of Mobil Exploration Mediterranean which were also sold to Petrom last year.
They said the joint venture was still working on the size and other details of the joint deal including when the exploration would begin.
